stories.title: Sloppy Socceroos given a reality check as Jordan dominate in friendly win
summary: Jordan 2-0 Australia (Al-Taamari 34, Ali Olwan 90+3)Socceroos had just one effort on target in defeatIn their final game of 2026, the Socceroos were given a reminder that they remain a work in progress, beaten 2-0 by Jordan in an international friendly where the scoreline failed to reflect the first-half siege the victors laid on their opponent’s goal, nor the unforced errors and brain fades that helped doom the Australians’ hopes of firing a shot in response.Optimism was high for those in green and gold after their comfortable win against the reigning Asian champions Qatar on Friday but very quickly on Tuesday it was made apparent that the Jordanians were to provide far more spirited opposition.

This time around it would be the Australians that were to be the subject of a first-half onslaught, as a Jordan team inspired by Musa al-Taamari launched forward with wicked pace and ruthless intent whenever the opportunity, or space left by the Socceroo defence, presented itself.
